resources.subject: Mathematics
resources.concept: Basic concepts of odd and even numbers with addition and subtraction operations
resources.description: The Odd-Even game with cards is a simple card game where players try to predict if the sum of the numbers on two cards will be odd or even. In the game, each player takes turns drawing two cards from a deck. If the sum of the two cards' numbers is odd, the "odd" side wins; if it’s even, the "even" side wins. For example, if the cards drawn are 3 and 4, their sum is 7, which is odd, so the odd side wins. Players bet on whether the sum will be odd or even before the cards are revealed.

resources.name: સમજદાર વપરાશ

resources.concept: Basic concepts of profit & loss, operations, budgeting and finance management
resources.description: A simple game where you manage your monthly budget using cards. Each card represents an expense like rent, food, or entertainment. At the start, you get a set amount of money. Every turn, you draw cards and decide how to pay for the expenses without running out of money. You must plan carefully to balance your spending, save some money, and avoid  overspending. The goal is to finish the month with money left over. The game helps you practice budgeting skills, make smart financial decisions, and understand the importance of managing money effectively.

Players take turns rolling the dice, moving their game pieces, and identifying fractions represented on the spaces they land on. If necessary, they simplify the fraction and place a bingo chip on the corresponding fraction on the game board. The objective is to get three chips in a row (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) to win. This game is perfect for practicing fraction skills in an exciting and hands-on way.

The wheel determines whether they move forward (+1, +2) or backward (-1, -2). The goal is to be the first to reach exactly 10. If a spin would take a player beyond 10, they must wait for the exact number needed. The game adds excitement with unpredictable turns, making it a thrilling race to the finish!
